title: BanglaAbuseMeme: A Dataset for Bengali Abusive Meme Classification
measurement_description: The paper measures the performance of various models in detecting abusive memes in the Bengali language. One of the specific categories of abuse measured is content targeting religious groups. This includes identifying hateful terms and derogatory content directed at individuals or communities based on their religion.
base_benchmarks: Maity et al. (2022) cyberbullying detection dataset
findings: In zero-shot, target-wise classification, the best multimodal model (CLIP(L)) achieved high precision and a high F1-score for the abusive class within the 'religion' target category. However, this was counterbalanced by increased misclassification of non-abusive memes in the same category, which adversely affected the overall macro F1-score for that target.
